description:
v1.0 | 8717 gates | 192 ticks
https://github.com/byggmesterPRO/pareto-circuits

Divides a by b, two 32-bit numbers. Dividing by 0 gives all ones.

Use this circuit wherever a creation has to divide one whole number by another, for example in a calculator or in the arithmetic part of a computer.

It divides one unsigned binary number a by another, b, and returns the quotient and the remainder, both read least significant digit first. Dividing by zero gives a quotient of all ones and a remainder equal to a. So avoid a divisor of zero.

Inputs (yellow gates, first row, lowest bit first): a = x 0-31, b = x 32-63.
Outputs (green gates): quotient = x 0-31, remainder = x 32-63.

Profile: fast, the build with the fewest ticks for this size.
How it works: Every bit sees its carry in one step, so the ticks do not grow with the size.
Checked on about a million inputs in a simulator. Gates include the input gates; ticks count the input gate too.
